required_capabilities: Move Element (×3); Inspect Project (×1); Check Clash (×1)
instruction: The project opens in a 3D view. The windows near (11400, 4305), (6300, 4405) and (6300, 105) are wrongly placed and clash with other elements. Repair them: keep each window's type and size, and move each so no opening clashes with anything. Do not modify any walls, and the window near (2200, 105) also clashes (its head rises above the wall top, lower it or shorten it); leave every other opening untouched.
